title: CTGAN
summary: A single Python script that runs a grid search over CTGAN hyperparameters using SDV's CTGANSynthesizer on a tabular dataset of 'non-shows' records, then evaluates the synthetic output. SDV's single-table CTGAN synthesizer, metadata schema, and evaluate_quality report are directly imported and executed.
evidence: CTGAN.py:3-5,34 imports CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, evaluate_quality and instantiates CTGANSynthesizer in a hyperparameter grid loop
needs: No README to confirm domain; 'non-shows' dataset likely refers to appointment no-shows (healthcare) but industry is inferred, not stated
